test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some markers are frogs.

All frogs are combs.

No comb is a stove.

**Conclusions:**

I. All markers being stove is a possibility.

II. Some combs are markers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c90415256ed59a08919bf6ad5cdc463a85a6f444d00351cca2446056e4f577e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All markers being stove is a possibility → False (Because, those part of frogs which is market can never be stove).

II. Some combs are markers → **True** (Because, those part of markers which is frogs will definitely combs).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows"**.
